[element-journal-id]
=== `<journal-id>` Journal Identifier in a Related Article

Within a related article (<<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>) or similar element, this element is the short code or abbreviation that represents the journal; used as an alternative to or short form of the journal title; used for identification of the journal domain.

* <<attribute-assigning-authority,`@assigning-authority`>>
